Become AI Native - Live Workshop, Wed Oct 7
FOR SERVICE-BUSINESS OWNERS · $50K+/MO
Use AI to Handle More Client Work With the Team You Already Have

In 90 minutes, find the repeat work slowing your team down, build and test one AI workflow, and leave with a seven-day rollout plan.

LIVE WED OCT 7 · 7 PM ET · REPLAY INCLUDED
Register for Free
Free live workshop · Wednesday, October 7 at 7 PM ET

90 minutes live · 72-hour replay included · free registration

“

We no longer have those panicking moments every month.

Operations lead at a client clinic, on what changed after installing an AI front desk
WED OCT 7 · 7 PM ET
90 MINUTES, LIVE
FOR $50K+/MO OWNERS
NO CODING
THE PROBLEM
Your best people are doing $15/hr work

Following up with inquiries. Pulling the weekly report together. Chasing documents. Turning meetings into action items. Answering the same customer questions. None of it is hard. It's constant, and it lands on the people you need doing the $500/hr work that drives revenue.

Most teams try AI like a search bar: ask a question, copy the answer, change nothing. On Oct 7 you'll give AI the context to do one of those jobs properly, and check that it did.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD
5 things you leave with

Hands-on, in your own Claude account (the free plan works). Fictional sample data is provided, so you never connect a business system.

01
Your Priority Brief

A 10-minute AI interview finds the three recurring tasks eating your team's week, estimates the hours, and picks the one to fix first.

02
Your Company Brain

Your offer, voice, rules and how this one process works, saved so AI stops starting from zero every chat.

03
One Tested Workflow

Pick a starter kit: sales follow-up, weekly reporting, document tracking, meeting follow-through or customer support. Run it, test the edge cases, and check it against an answer key.

04
Your Seven-Day Plan

Run it on your real business this week and measure whether it actually saves time.

05
Live Q&A and Hands-On Help

Finish anything you started and get answers for your business.

FIT
Who this is for
This is for you if
You run a service business doing $50K+ a month with a team of 3–50
Your best people spend hours a week on follow-up, reporting and admin
You've tried ChatGPT or a tool or two and nothing changed how the business runs
Not for you if
You want a prompt-writing course
You want to start an AI agency
You want to watch, not build
YOUR SEAT
YOUR FREE SEAT
Free
No payment or card required.
90-minute live, hands-on workshop (Wed Oct 7, 7 PM ET)
The 22-file attendee packet: audit and brain prompts, project instructions, worksheet, results log and seven-day plan
5 ready-to-use workflow kits: sales follow-up, weekly reporting, document tracking, meeting follow-through, customer support
Live Q&A and hands-on help
72-hour replay. Can't make it live? You still get the replay and the full packet.
Register for Free
FROM THE HOSTS
Why we're running this

Most owners know AI matters. Few have seen it do one real job inside their business, with the context and the checks that make it trustworthy. That's the whole point of these 90 minutes: you build it yourself, in your own account, with us helping.

Nick has built a seven-figure AI business and taught thousands of people how to put AI to work. Keshav is the CTO of Reprise AI and builds the systems our clients run every day.

— Nick Puru & Keshav Sukirya, Reprise AI

QUESTIONS
Before you join
Do I need to be technical?
No. If you can use email and a spreadsheet, you can do this. No code, no software to buy.
What do I need?
A Claude account you've signed into beforehand (the free plan works). Sample data is provided, so you never connect a business system.
How long is it?
90 minutes, including Q&A and hands-on help.
Is there a replay?
Yes. Every registrant gets the 72-hour replay and the full packet, even if you can't make it live. The Q&A and hands-on help only happen live.
Is this a pitch?
You spend the session building. At the end we take a few minutes to explain how we work with businesses that want it done for them. The packet and replay are yours either way.
Can my team watch?
Yes. Share this page so each person can register for free and get their own reminders.
